<p>Sing it, Tommy boy! Good things come to those who wait and&nbsp;never more so than this past weekend!</p><p>&nbsp;We saw clemson fans wait out a rain delay to overcome a deficit of 14 points against unc finding a way to win in the end. Not throwing stones – Alabama followed the same rain plan…once again a slow start for the Tide… due to keeping Keelon’s headset operating a little longer than it should have been allowed to stay on? The communication equipment must have gotten wet during the rain delays (right?) allowing <em>Keelon</em> to turn it on (turn <em>himself</em> on not the headphones) with 376 all-purpose yards no less!</p><p>&nbsp;Tide fans had good reason to be patient in the end and perhaps should serve as examples for a lesser-known sports drama episode…you may or may not be aware arkansas is NOT happy with their new coach…to the point, fans initiated an <em>Empty Out </em>this weekend - think <em>Black Out</em> or <em>White Out </em>but instead of wearing a specific color to the game you wear whatever you want and do not attend the game…an actual boycott of the game?! That is just a little bit too petty…for even Tom Petty, don’t you think?!&nbsp;</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64," height="320" width="240"></p><p>You may recall from <em>Past Takes</em> (December 15, 2025 to be exact) of the Wuskaloosa Report (when it was just an email) the raucous protest the students had when their new coach Ryan Silverfield was named. The sheer numbers participating were feared to be a threat to invoke violence.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>But they have not even given the poor fellow half a season before throwing in the towel?! I know Alabama fans expect a lot too, but come on pigs, how are you going to ever get someone to stick around for arkansas football if you don’t at least give them a shot to get the program going? Illchay outay ogshay! (Pig Latin for “Chill out hogs!”)</p><p>&nbsp;I mean, take a tip on patience from aub fans…losing to the gators this past Saturday means they have now gone 668 days without a sec win at jordan hare stadium! And now they are likely going to see that terrible streak come to an end this weekend as they host vandy Saturday…although, after the voodoo vandy pulled&nbsp;&nbsp;to beat nc state,the boogs may need to sacrifice an extra chicken or something to ensure the home field hex goes <em>their</em> way this weekend.&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;Moving on...once the Tide took care of the seminoles, we <em>lovers of all that is college football</em> could turn our attention to the <em>Hate Bowl</em> and enjoy seeing the <em>fighting Petes</em> restore a sense of romantic justice to the sports world. Not much can be said that has not already been stated about the beauty of the lsu loss, but once again, just as we saw during his time at Tennessee, lane kiffin demonstrated his super power to unite our country in disgust directed solely at him!&nbsp;</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64," height="249" width="320"></p><p> The complete harmony and agreement that <em>lane hatred</em> has inspired is pretty awe-inspiring – no political, racial or class tensions here – just all one-sided <em>love </em>rooting against<em> evil</em>…like Rocky vs. Ivan Drago of Russia in Rocky 4, the momma lioness preventing a clan of hyenas from eating her cub in nature videos or yourself against the world looking for a parking spot at any retail store during holiday season…and just like the movies and not like Costco on Christmas Eve – the good guys won!&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;What was the most remarkable about the victory was that despite all of lane’s cockiness prior to the game, Ole Miss never doubted their win. <u>Everyone</u> of the Rebel persuasion prepared for the victory. We thought Pete lost his mind going for two on his last td when he did not really need to, but Pete said they practiced the two-point conversion all week so they could execute it when they wanted the edge and not as a go-to forced play.&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;And sure, it was clever after the win for Ole Miss to play Garth Brooks’ <em>Calling Baton Rouge</em> and <em>You’s a Hoe</em> by Ludracris over the loud speaker, but that’s easy to do – you just download a song and press play. What is much more impressive is the entire Ole Miss band was so certain of the win they rehearsed and learned how to play lsu’s taunting anthem <em>Neck </em>(similar to Alabama’s Ramma Jamma but much more vulgar)…and then performed it for the tigers with the entire stadium putting an Ole Miss spin on it. Yes, you understood that correctly – the Ole Miss band practiced and played another school’s “mock” song so they could shoot it right back at them…bravo!  And while <em>Neck</em> is crude even by lsu’s terms when played Saturday night…it somehow became adorable through the Ole Miss drum major’s smile!</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64," height="640" width="296"></p><p>&nbsp;The fans did their part too – they were loud the whole game, stayed in the stands after the game celebrating but <u>no one</u> rushed the field.&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;Pete, who we Alabama fans unfortunately treated poorly during his tenure at UA, was savvy and a total class act having ample opportunity to dog lane in his press conference but never took the bait and only spoke of the future goals of his team.&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;So, lane is 1-9 now on road games against top 10 teams. Pete became the first CFB coach to beat four ranked teams in his first six games as a head coach - 2025 CFP - #17 Tulane, CFP Quarter final - #2 georgia, 2026 - #24 Louisville (who beat smu handily this past Saturday!) and as you may have heard #7 tigers.&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;Is there actually room in our hearts for more joy?! If we can endure the wait, we get to do it all again this weekend!&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;Many thanks to the kentucky wildcats for setting up a great football scenario this upcoming weekend by scratching out the eyes of the aggies last Saturday despite the overconfidence of the tx am yell leader at their pep rally stating about uk,</p><p>“They figured out how to live in trailers, and they definitely figured out how to marry their cousins, but they never figured out how to play football!”&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;<a href="https://www.secrant.com/sec-football/aandm-yell-leader-goes-after-kentucky-fans-saying-their-hillbillies-and-live-in-trailers/124869307/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">https://www.secrant.com/sec-football/aandm-yell-leader-goes-after-kentucky-fans-saying-their-hillbillies-and-live-in-trailers/124869307/</a></p><p>As a result of uk’s outstanding <em>Caturday</em> in college station, either tx am or lsu will be 0-2 in sec play when these two teams face off Saturday night in tiger stadium! That’s two teams who hoped to be playing for the sec championship with hopes dashed before half the season is over! Too much fun!</p><p>&nbsp;Don’t forget ole miss is headed to gatorville and the volatiles are hosting the baby sarks early in knoxvegas! God bless America!</p><p>&nbsp;Enjoy Week 4 and let’s beat the gamecocks! RTR!</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Jackie&nbsp;</p>
